definition: Eric Brill is a computer scientist specializing in natural language processing.
details: He created the Brill tagger, a supervised part of speech tagger. Another research paper of Brill introduced a machine learning technique now known as transformation-based learning.
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. That pattern-earned fluency is Eric Brill.
